block_movements_target_reps_range_check.name: block_movements_target_reps_range_check
block_movements_target_reps_range_check.value: "block_movements"."target_reps_min" is null or "block_movements"."target_reps_max" is null or "block_movements"."target_reps_max" >= "block_movements"."target_reps_min"

content_reports_details_check.name: content_reports_details_check
content_reports_details_check.value:
(
        "content_reports"."reason" <> 'other'
        and ("content_reports"."details" is null or length(btrim("content_reports"."details")) between 1 and 500)
      ) or (
        "content_reports"."reason" = 'other'
        and length(btrim("content_reports"."details")) between 1 and 500
      )

goals_slot_state_check.name: goals_slot_state_check
goals_slot_state_check.value:
(
        "goals"."state" = 'active'
        and "goals"."active_slot" between 1 and 5
      ) or (
        "goals"."state" <> 'active'
        and "goals"."active_slot" is null
      )

goals_definition_check.name: goals_definition_check
goals_definition_check.value:
(
        "goals"."kind" = 'volume'
        and "goals"."metric" in ('workout_count', 'distance', 'minutes')
        and "goals"."pr_kind" is null
        and "goals"."pr_key" is null
        and (
          (
            "goals"."schedule" in ('weekly', 'monthly')
          ) or (
            "goals"."schedule" = 'one_time'
            and "goals"."deadline_at" is not null
          )
        )
        and (
          "goals"."sport_filter" is null
          or (
            "goals"."metric" = 'distance'
            and "goals"."sport_filter" in ('run', 'walk', 'cycling')
          )
          or (
            "goals"."metric" in ('workout_count', 'minutes')
            and "goals"."sport_filter" in (
              'run', 'walk', 'cycling', 'strength_training', 'powerlifting',
              'hiit', 'functional_fitness', 'other'
            )
          )
        )
      ) or (
        "goals"."kind" = 'time'
        and "goals"."metric" = 'time'
        and "goals"."schedule" = 'one_time'
        and "goals"."pr_kind" = 'distance_time'
        and "goals"."pr_key" is not null
        and "goals"."sport_filter" in ('run', 'walk', 'cycling')
      ) or (
        "goals"."kind" = 'lift'
        and "goals"."metric" = 'load'
        and "goals"."schedule" = 'one_time'
        and "goals"."pr_kind" = 'heaviest_single'
        and "goals"."pr_key" is not null
      )

set_results_distance_unit_check.name: set_results_distance_unit_check
set_results_distance_unit_check.value: ("set_results"."distance" is null) = ("set_results"."distance_unit" is null) and ("set_results"."distance_unit" is null or "set_results"."distance_unit" in ('m', 'km', 'mi'))

workout_session_metrics_value_check.name: workout_session_metrics_value_check
workout_session_metrics_value_check.value: "workout_session_metrics"."numeric_value" is not null or "workout_session_metrics"."text_value" is not null

workout_session_segments_distance_check.name: workout_session_segments_distance_check
workout_session_segments_distance_check.value: ("workout_session_segments"."distance" is null and "workout_session_segments"."distance_unit" is null) or ("workout_session_segments"."distance" > 0 and "workout_session_segments"."distance_unit" in ('m', 'km', 'mi'))

workout_session_segments_result_check.name: workout_session_segments_result_check
workout_session_segments_result_check.value: "workout_session_segments"."distance" is not null or "workout_session_segments"."duration_seconds" is not null or "workout_session_segments"."recovery_seconds" is not null

workout_sessions_format_columns_null_che.name: workout_sessions_format_columns_null_check
workout_sessions_format_columns_null_che.value:
"workout_sessions"."workout_format" is not null or (
        "workout_sessions"."format_duration_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_interval_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_rounds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_finished" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_rounds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_reps" is null
      )

workout_sessions_positive_values_check.name: workout_sessions_positive_values_check

workout_sessions_amrap_shape_check.name: workout_sessions_amrap_shape_check
workout_sessions_amrap_shape_check.value:
"workout_sessions"."workout_format" <> 'amrap' or (
        "workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_finished" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_interval_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_rounds" is null
        and ("workout_sessions"."score_reps" is null or "workout_sessions"."score_rounds" is not null)
      )

workout_sessions_for_time_shape_check.name: workout_sessions_for_time_shape_check
workout_sessions_for_time_shape_check.value:
"workout_sessions"."workout_format" <> 'for_time' or (
        "workout_sessions"."format_duration_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_interval_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_rounds" is null
        and (
          (
            "workout_sessions"."score_finished" is null
            and "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" is null
            and "workout_sessions"."score_reps" is null
          ) or (
            "workout_sessions"."score_finished" = true
            and "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" is not null
            and "workout_sessions"."score_reps" is null
            and ("workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds" is null or "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" <= "workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds")
          ) or (
            "workout_sessions"."score_finished" = false
            and "workout_sessions"."score_reps" is not null
            and "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" is null
            and "workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds" is not null
          )
        )
      )

workout_sessions_emom_shape_check.name: workout_sessions_emom_shape_check
workout_sessions_emom_shape_check.value:
"workout_sessions"."workout_format" <> 'emom' or (
        "workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_finished" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_time_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_rounds" is null
      )

workout_sessions_rounds_shape_check.name: workout_sessions_rounds_shape_check
workout_sessions_rounds_shape_check.value:
"workout_sessions"."workout_format" <> 'rounds' or (
        "workout_sessions"."format_duration_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."format_interval_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."time_cap_seconds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_finished" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_rounds" is null
        and "workout_sessions"."score_reps" is null
      )
